_howto: ESS Master tours. steps = page tour. sections = one tour per screen (first visit) plus pop-up form tours (overlay, offered the first time). Guides are in essmaster_guides.json. Never reuse a step id.
title: ESS Master tour
whatsNewText: We've added something new here since you last took the tour.

steps.title: Welcome to ESS Master
steps.text:
Everything behind employee self-service: requests to approve, leave and its rules, claims, payroll periods and sending to payroll, payslips, documents and messages to the app.

Use Next and Back, or your arrow keys. Press Esc to close.

steps.title: All ESS screens
steps.text: Every screen is listed here. You only see the ones your role allows.

steps.title: Dashboard
steps.text: Your ESS day at a glance: requests waiting, who is off, thin days, balances and claims - with charts. Click any card or chart to go straight to its screen.

steps.title: Mobile Requests
steps.text: Leave, overtime and profile changes employees asked for in the app, waiting to be approved or rejected.

steps.title: Leave Transactions
steps.text: Approved leave. Cancelling a record here gives the days back.

steps.title: HR Module
steps.text: HR Management (contracts, infringements, performance), opened inside ESS.

steps.title: Setting up leave
steps.text: Leave Types, Leave Policies (entitlements and accrual), Pack Linkage (which departments get which policy), Bulk Leave (shutdowns and company days) and Leave Take-On (opening balances).

steps.title: Claims
steps.text: Every claim with its receipt and payment (Register), and the claim types people can choose with their rules (Claim Types).

steps.title: Payroll
steps.text: Payroll periods, and Send To Payroll: approved leave and claims for a period, sent once and never picked up twice.

steps.title: Leave at a glance
steps.text: Leave Dashboard, Leave Calendar (who's away when) and Reports.

steps.title: Payslips
steps.text: Every payslip published to employees, to view or download.

steps.title: Document Center
steps.text: Policies and documents for employees to read and acknowledge in the app.

steps.title: Global Broadcasts
steps.text: Send a message straight to the mobile app and web portal.

steps.title: Trips and locations
steps.text: Live Trip Logs (driving routes and distances) and Locate Employees (latest locations and movement trails).

steps.title: App Settings
steps.text: When managers are emailed about new leave and expense requests.

steps.title: Global Settings
steps.text: System preferences, who approves what (Workflow Routing), and payroll periods.

steps.title: Make more room
steps.text: Collapse the menu to icons only, and click again to open it.

steps.title: Search any screen
steps.text: Type what you're looking for, like leave calendar or payslips, to jump straight to any screen you have access to, in any module.

steps.title: Your menu
steps.text: Click your name for your profile, other areas of the system, Dark Mode and logout.

steps.title: Launchpad
steps.text: Back to your home screen with all your modules.

steps.title: Help & Tours
steps.text: Opens the same help menu as the ? button.

steps.title: Dark Mode
steps.text: Switch between dark and light. Your choice follows your login to any computer.

steps.title: Help is always here
steps.text: Click ? for this tour, a tour of the screen you're on, what's new, and hands-on how-to guides such as approving a request or sending to payroll.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.text: Each screen also has its own short tour. It starts the first time you open that screen, and you can replay it any time from ?.

steps.title: Pending Requests
steps.text: How many requests are waiting for you. Click it to open them.

steps.title: Your day at a glance
steps.text: Requests waiting (red when some are over a week old), who's off today and in the next two weeks, days when too many people are off, negative balances, open claims, and anyone on no payroll period. Click a card to open its screen.

steps.title: One department
steps.text: Show every card and chart for one department, or all the departments you may see. Your choice is remembered. Refresh loads the latest numbers.

steps.title: People off - next 14 days
steps.text: A bar per day with how many people are off. A red bar means a department is too thin that day (20% or more off). Click a bar to see the departments.

steps.title: Requests waiting
steps.text: The requests waiting for approval, by age: green from today or yesterday, amber 3 to 7 days, red over a week. Click the ring to open Mobile Requests.

steps.title: Balances health
steps.text: Negative and zero balances per leave type, next to the people with the most annual leave owing.

steps.title: Off today
steps.text: Everyone on leave today, with the leave type.

steps.title: Thin days
steps.text: Days in the next two weeks when a department has too many people off. Worth checking before approving more leave for those days.

steps.title: Negative or zero balances
steps.text: People who have used more leave than they have, or have none left.

steps.title: Find requests
steps.text: Filter by date, department or employee, then click Filter.

steps.title: Each request
steps.text: When it was asked for, who, what (leave, overtime or a profile change), the detail and their balance, and the Current Level: which approval step it's waiting on.

steps.title: Approve or reject
steps.text: Approve or Reject each request. For leave, you choose which leave type to take it from and can make it partial hours. View Attachment opens any proof sent with it.

steps.title: Bulk Approve
steps.text: Tick requests (or the box at the top of the list for all of them) and approve them in one go.

steps.title: More requests
steps.text: Move through the list.

steps.title: Find leave
steps.text: Filter by date, department or employee, then click Filter.

steps.title: Approved leave
steps.text: Each day of leave taken: the leave type, hours, and any proof.

steps.title: Cancel Leave
steps.text: Cancelling a record gives the leave back to the employee's balance. Use it when someone didn't take leave after all.

steps.title: Two parts
steps.text: Periods: the cycles payroll runs on. Send To Payroll: hand over approved leave and claims for a period.

steps.title: New Period
steps.text: A monthly, weekly or fortnightly cycle.

steps.title: Your periods
steps.text:
Each period with its cycle, how many departments and employees are on it, and its latest windows.
• Units: the departments on it.
• Override: individual employees on it, whatever their department.
• Lock a window once payroll for it is final; locked production can't be changed in Production Pay.

steps.title: Nobody left out
steps.text: A warning appears when active employees are on no period at all. Their leave and claims can't be sent until they are.

steps.title: Send To Payroll
steps.text: Choose the period and the window.

steps.title: What Would Send
steps.text: Shows every approved leave day and claim in that window that hasn't been sent yet, before anything is sent.

steps.title: Sent batches
steps.text: Every send, with its period, window and totals. Download a batch for payroll, or unsend it so its items go in the next send.

steps.title: Find a payslip
steps.text: Search by name or PIN, or pick a department.

steps.title: Payslips
steps.text: The pay period, employee and when it was published. View opens it; Download saves the PDF.

steps.title: Upload Document
steps.text: A policy, procedure or notice for employees, to everyone, one department or one person.

steps.title: Find a document
steps.text: Search, or filter by tag.

steps.title: Your documents
steps.text: Who it was sent to, its version, and how many people have acknowledged reading it. Track shows exactly who has and hasn't. Edit uploads a new version.

steps.title: Add Leave Type
steps.text: The kinds of leave people can ask for, such as Annual, Sick or Family Responsibility.

steps.title: Your leave types
steps.text: Whether each one is paid, when proof must be attached, and whether it's active. How much people get and how it builds up is set on Leave Policies, not here.

steps.title: Who owns the balances
steps.text: Payroll System: a connected payroll keeps leave balances and they're pulled from it. Our Leave Policies: balances are built up here from the policies below. Choose one; the text explains what changes.

steps.title: New Policy
steps.text: A set of leave rules, for example Permanent Staff or Seasonal Workers. It can start as a copy of another policy.

steps.title: Your policies
steps.text: The live version, how many leave types it covers, how many departments are linked to it, and any change coming up. Open a policy to see and change its rules.

steps.title: Versions
steps.text: Every version with the date it starts. Changes never overwrite history: a new version starts from a date you choose.

steps.title: The rules
steps.text: Per leave type: the entitlement, the cycle, how it builds up (rhythm, rate and anchor: normal weeks or the payroll cycle), how far negative it may go, who is eligible, and when proof or HR is needed.

steps.title: Draft, then publish
steps.text: Only a draft can be edited. Save Draft keeps your changes, Publish makes it live from its start date, Discard drops the draft. Change From Date starts a new draft from a future date.

steps.title: Policy and date
steps.text: Choose the policy and the date it applies from.

steps.title: Departments
steps.text: Tick the departments that get this policy. Everyone in them inherits it, including people who join later.

steps.title: Preview
steps.text: Shows, person by person, what would change before anything is saved. Then Apply Linkage.

steps.title: Personal exceptions
steps.text: Leave this unticked to keep anyone's personal policy or individual overrides. Tick it only to reset them to the department's policy.

steps.title: What and when
steps.text: The leave type, the dates and a reason, for example a year-end shutdown.

steps.title: Who
steps.text: A unit or all your staff, then tick the people in the list.

steps.title: Check Who Can Go
steps.text: Shows who it works for (with the days and their balance afterwards) and who it doesn't, with the reason, before anything is sent.

steps.title: Individual requests
steps.text: Submit Requests creates one request per person, so each follows the normal approval and appears in their history.

steps.title: Template
steps.text: Download the spreadsheet layout. Columns are matched by name, so Employee Number, Emp No and PIN all work.

steps.title: What you're loading
steps.text: Opening balances when you start using ESS leave, or historic transactions (leave already taken).

steps.title: Check File
steps.text: Every row is checked first. Nothing is written until you choose Load Clean Rows. Rejected rows come with the reason and can be downloaded as an error file to fix.

steps.title: Past loads
steps.text: Every load, with how many rows went in and how many were rejected, when and by whom.

steps.title: Two views
steps.text: Unit Manager: your departments this week. HR & Operations: the whole company.

steps.title: Your units
steps.text: Off today and over the next two weeks, the inbox, negative balances, thin days and open claims. Filter by unit above.

steps.title: Next two weeks
steps.text: Who's booked off per day. Amber marks a day the unit is already thin.

steps.title: Sick pattern
steps.text: Sick leave in the last eight weeks, counted in occasions (separate absences), with how many fell on a Monday.

steps.title: HR & Operations
steps.text: Leave owed to staff, leave advanced, how long approvals take, requests missing notes, claims missing receipts, people on their own rules, and open claims. Below: how much each department uses of what it earns.

steps.title: Unit
steps.text: Choose a unit, and move between months with the arrows. The gear sets when a day counts as thin.

steps.title: Who's away
steps.text: Solid is approved leave, outlined is still waiting for approval. Days with too many people off are marked.

steps.title: A day's detail
steps.text: Click a day to see who's off and whether the unit still has enough people. Decisions are made in the inbox: Open the inbox to decide.

steps.title: Pick a report
steps.text: Search or choose a report on the left.

steps.title: The report
steps.text: What question it answers and who it's for, its filters, and the results. Download saves it as a spreadsheet.

steps.title: Register and Claim Types
steps.text: Register: every claim, its receipt and its payment. Claim Types: what people can claim for on the phone and in ESS, and the rules for each (receipt, rate, approval, payroll code).

steps.title: Search
steps.text: Find a claim by name, employee number, type, unit or notes as you type.

steps.title: Filters
steps.text: Status, claim type, dates (with This month / Last month quick picks), receipt, department and payroll (not sent / sent / paid). The filters on show appear as chips you can remove one by one.

steps.title: Columns
steps.text: Pick and order the columns. Click a heading to sort, drag it to move it, and use the box under a heading to search just that column. Remembered for you.

steps.title: Data Tools
steps.text: Export this view (Excel with your columns), the full register, PDF claim forms of the ticked claims, and Claims by site.

steps.title: Open a claim
steps.text: Click a claim to see it in full with its receipt, its approval history, and buttons for the claim PDF, the receipt image and Mark paid. Tick claims to do this for many at once.

steps.title: Find claims
steps.text: Filter by status (pending, approved or rejected), claim type, dates, and whether a receipt is attached or missing, or search by name.

steps.title: Totals
steps.text: The count and value of the claims you've filtered.

steps.title: Each claim
steps.text: Date, employee, unit, type, amount, receipt, status, and who captured and approved it.

steps.title: By Site
steps.text: Approved claims per unit: claims, claimants, headcount, total and per head. A site spending more than twice the average per head is flagged.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: The filtered claims as a spreadsheet, for payment.

steps.title: Add Expense Type
steps.text: What people can claim for, such as Travel, Meals or Tools.

steps.title: Your expense types
steps.text: How each is worked out: Simple (the employee enters the amount), Fixed (you set the payout), or Rate-based (for example a rate per kilometre). Plus whether a receipt is required, and whether it's active.

steps.title: The message
steps.text: A title and the message. It appears straight away in the mobile app and web portal.

steps.title: Who gets it
steps.text: Everyone, one department, one person, or a custom list of people.

steps.title: Attachment and send
steps.text: Add a file if needed, then Send Broadcast.

steps.title: Sent messages
steps.text: Every broadcast with its audience and attachment. Filter by date.

steps.title: Find a trip
steps.text: Search by driver or PIN. Refresh Logs loads the latest trips.

steps.title: Trips
steps.text: Each trip logged in the app: the driver, start and end time, and distance. Open a trip to see its route.

steps.title: What to show
steps.text: Dates, an optional time window, and a department. Pick one employee to see their breadcrumb trail: where they were, in order.

steps.title: Locate
steps.text: Shows the latest locations (or the trail) on the map, and each location in the list below.

steps.title: Map and list
steps.text: Click a pin or a row to see who, where and when.

steps.title: When managers are emailed
steps.text: Instant: an email for each new leave or expense request. Daily Batch: one summary a day, at the time you choose.

steps.title: Do Not Disturb
steps.text: Emails created between these times wait until the morning. Tick Skip Weekends to hold Friday afternoon's emails until Monday.

steps.title: Save Mailer Rules
steps.text: Nothing changes until you save.

steps.title: Three tabs
steps.text: System Preferences, Workflow Routing (who approves) and Payroll Periods.

steps.title: Employee Data Source
steps.text: Where ESS gets its employee records: from this system, synced from another system, or uploaded from CSV.

steps.title: Workflow Routing
steps.text: Who approves requests, in order: 1st, 2nd and 3rd approver, plus a standing (backup) approver. Set it for a whole department, or for one employee (which overrides their department).

steps.title: Routing rules
steps.text: Every rule you've set. A request moves to the next approver each time it's approved.

steps.title: Payroll Periods
steps.text: Payroll periods are now set up on the Payroll screen. This tab lists them for reference.

steps.title: HR Management in ESS
steps.text: The full HR Management module, opened inside ESS, with its own ? (bottom left of this area) for its tours and guides.
